work.milestone.end.handed: Not reached: its work was handed off. {{said}}
work.milestone.by.merged: every commit of it is on {{on}}
work.milestone.by.on-line: its files read on {{on}} as it left them
work.milestone.by.pull-request: its pull request completed and its merge commit is on {{on}}
work.milestone.by.landed: its work is on {{on}}, which the line holds
work.milestone.by.carried: a completed pull request carried it and its merge commit is on the line
work.milestone.by.inside: it is inside {{on}}, whose work is on the line
work.milestone.result.label: Result
work.milestone.cleanup.label: Clean-up
work.milestone.cleanup.completedNone: Completed: nothing was left to clean up
work.milestone.recovery.label: Recovery
work.milestone.wait.title: {{unit}}: its clean-up is blocked
work.milestone.wait.owner: Nothing records whose work this is, so nothing of it is cleaned up.
work.milestone.code.unfollowed: its session recorded it, but no branch record follows {{branch}}, so the look never cleans it up: the session branches on its workspace’s Branches remove it
work.milestone.code.unread: git could not read which branch it is on, so it is not cleaned up
work.milestone.code.unknown-folder: nothing records whose it is, and no repository is linked to this folder, so nothing of it is cleaned up until you say
work.milestone.code.unknown-unread: nothing records whose it is, and git could not read which branch it is on, so nothing of it is cleaned up
work.milestone.code.unknown-branch: nothing records {{branch}}, so nothing of it is cleaned up: Discard branch… in the session branches on its workspace’s Branches removes it
work.milestone.code.unrecorded: Daoris did not record {{branch}}, so nothing of it is cleaned up: Discard branch… in the session branches on its workspace’s Branches removes it
work.milestone.code.kept.in-use: the look kept it, since a session running or waiting holds its tree; it is tried again at the next look
work.milestone.code.kept.dirty: the look kept it, since its tree holds uncommitted or untracked work
work.milestone.code.kept.busy: the look kept it, since something on this machine holds its tree’s folder open; it is tried again at the next look
work.milestone.code.kept.hidden: the look kept it, since a tracked path in its tree hides its changes
work.milestone.code.kept.nested: the look kept it, since its tree holds another repository
work.milestone.code.kept.linked: the look kept it, since its tree is reached through a link
work.milestone.code.kept.refused: the look kept it, since its removal did not happen: its tree is locked, git would not let its record go, or the branch moved
work.milestone.code.kept.unread: the look kept it, since git could not read one of its guards; it is tried again at the next look
work.milestone.code.kept.starting: the look kept it, since a session was starting in one of the repository’s trees; it is tried again at the next look
work.milestone.code.kept.sessions: the look kept it, since the service did not say which sessions run; it is tried again at the next look

work.milestone.held.title: {{node}}, attempt {{attempt}}
work.milestone.held.step: {{node}}, attempt {{attempt}}: {{why}}. It waits for your word.
work.milestone.held.detail: {{why}}. Nothing goes on until you say what became of it ({{step}}).
work.milestone.held.worded: {{node}}, attempt {{attempt}}: your word “{{word}}” is recorded, and the next look applies it.
work.milestone.held.recorded: Your word on {{node}} is recorded: the next look applies it.
work.milestone.held.why.unknown: Its plugin was asked and cannot say what became of it
work.milestone.held.why.no-reconcile: Its step declares no way to ask what became of it
work.milestone.held.why.no-outcome: Its plugin said it was done and named no outcome
work.milestone.held.why.not-current: The step moved off it while its effect may still run
work.milestone.held.why.not-on-word: Your word that it happened could not be taken: its results are its plugin's to give
work.milestone.held.why.other: Its plugin's answer did not bind to the work it was sent on ({{code}})
work.milestone.held.close.why.closed: The quest was closed, and Daoris could not record that on this work ({{code}})
work.milestone.held.close.why.refused: The quest's close was refused, and Daoris could not record that on this work ({{code}})
work.milestone.held.close.why.unanswered: Daoris keeps no answer to the quest's close ({{code}})
work.milestone.held.close.why.notCloseWo: Your word could not be taken: only the close's own answer says whether the quest closed
work.milestone.held.close.why.submission: The submission this close names was reopened or replaced since, so the work now is not this close's to record or stop; it can be sent again
work.milestone.held.close.detail: {{why}}. The quest is never closed a second time: record the answer again, ask for it again, or stop the rest of this work.
